faq:
Frequently Asked Questions

What is modern interior design for a home in Karnal?

Clean lines, open layouts, a calm colour palette and practical furniture. It suits new independent houses that want a fresh, uncluttered look.

Can modern design suit a joint family home?

Yes. Modern layouts can include more storage, flexible seating and separate private areas, so they work well for large families.

Is a modern home more expensive to build?

Not necessarily. Simple forms and fewer decorative details can even reduce cost. The budget depends mostly on materials and fittings.

How long does modern interior design last before it looks dated?

Because it relies on simple forms and good materials rather than trends, a well-done modern interior stays fresh for many years.
